reasoning_steps: Describe the result as either prime or not prime.
Assume the two categories are equally likely merely because there are two categories.
Report 1/2 without counting the integers in each category.
Correctly identify the 3 prime numbers 29, 31, and 37.
Count the inclusive range as 38−29 = 9, omitting the endpoint adjustment of +1.
Calculate 3/9 = 1/3.
Correctly count 10 integers and 3 prime numbers.
Answer for the complementary event, selecting a non-prime number.
Arrange all five digits in 5! = 120 ways.
Count arrangements beginning with 0 as valid five-digit numbers.
Report 120 without subtracting the invalid leading-zero arrangements.
Correctly identify 4 choices for the first digit and 24 arrangements for the remaining digits.
Omit the first factor when evaluating 4 × 24 and retain only 24.
Select 24.
Misread the question as fixing 1 as the leading digit rather than allowing any nonzero leading digit.
Arrange only the remaining digits 0, 2, 3, and 4.
Report 4! = 24.
Use addition rather than multiplication to combine the unit price and the number of sheets.
Calculate 21+4 = 25.
Report 25 paisa.
Set up 21 × 4 using tens and units.
Miscompute 4 × 2 as 9 in the tens column, while keeping 4 × 1 = 4 in the units column.
Combine the digits to report 94 paisa.
Overlook the tens digit in the price 21 and read the price as 1 paisa per sheet.
Multiply the misread price by 4 sheets.
Report 4 paisa.
Multiply the budget by the unit price instead of dividing.
Calculate 60 × 10 = 600.
Report 600 feet, ignoring the incompatible units of the multiplication.
Correctly set up the required division as 60/10.
Count one group of ten too many and report the quotient as 7.
Select ৭ ফুট.
Focus on the stated number 10 in the price per foot.
Report that price number as the requested length rather than using the 60-taka budget.
Select ১০ ফুট.
